Dread Hollow is a Location within the Underdark in Act One of Baldur's Gate 3. A major landmark of this location is a large and wide-spreading Sussur Tree.
“
What is this? These flowers - they make my blood run as cold as ice.
„
— Lae'zel, coming close to a Sussur tree bloom

Overview

The Dread Hollow occupies western and north-western parts of the Underdark region. The hollow forms a ring-like territory around a chasm, with a very large and brightly shining Sussur Tree growing in the middle[1]. To the north-east, a bunch of Knotted roots leads to a separate grotto overgrown with poisonous Bibberbang mushrooms.

Sussur Tree

In the western corner a cave on a rocky cliff can be found, where a mad drow wizard  Filro the Forgotten has made his haven. He becomes hostile to the party on sight, as well as several  Hook Horrors roaming around. Speaking to Filro's corpse afterwards or successfully examining the  Scribbled Notes looted from him may start the ⁠Adamantine Forge (quest), if not started already, or progress it.

By climbing onto a branch of the Sussur Tree at X: -14 Y: -138, the party can obtain a piece of  Sussur Tree Bark required to complete the ⁠Finish the Masterwork Weapon quest. Doing this earns the ⁠The Finest Ingredients inspirational event for the characters with  Guild Artisan background.

Also, the  flowers of this tree confer a  magic-sapping effect upon characters who come within range, preventing them from casting spells or cantrips. If picked up and placed into the character's inventory, these flowers also prevent nearby entities from doing the same.

Bibberbang Grotto

To the north-east from the Sussur Tree is a vast cave densely overgrown with dangerous Bibberbang mushrooms and their highly flammable spores.  Baelen Bonecloak is trapped among their stalks: he fell there holding a burning  torch from the stone perch which engirdles the cave inside. The party must decide whether to help Baelen or not, and also may try to collect a valuable  Noblestalk mushroom, which grows in the far end of the cave and is easily destroyed if even a single Bibberbang stalk is triggered to explode.

Helping Baelen to escape earns the ⁠A Lethal Endeavour inspiration event for party members with the  Folk Hero background. The Noblestalk, if successfully collected, can be consumed by  Shadowheart or the  Dark Urge to recover some lost memories from their past, and grants the ⁠A Noble Endeavour inspiration event for party members with the  Outlander background.

Also, on the stone perch at X: -12 Y: -50 the  Explorer's Ring can be looted from a skeleton. In the farmost corner of the grotto a big bunch of  Lolth's Candle crystals can be picked up.

Arcane Tower overlook

At the southmost point of the grotto, a vista opens onto the Arcane Tower and the lake below. Also, at X: -41 Y: -209 stands the tombstone of Myrna, a pet dog of Lenore de Hurst. Digging up the grave yields a  Dog Collar, which has a special interaction in the Arcane Tower if equipped by an active party member. Otherwise, if the party have already explored the Arcane Tower and read the  Letter from Amarith in the bedroom there, placing some  Autumncrocus on the grave grants approval from  +1,  +1 and  +1.

A Deep Hole

At X: 18 Y: -110, to the north-east of the Sussur tree is a Deep Hole with skeletal remains scattered around. Interacting with the hole prompts the Voice in the Deep Hole to respond with growls or roars. However, if  Speak with Animals is used, the same growling voice tells the party to run and not disturb it anymore, calling them "flesh-bags". The voice does not respond if the  Bulette is dead, suggesting that this is actually the creature the party is speaking to.

The eastern part of the Dread Hollow is one of areas where a Bulette can emerge from under surface. The same Letter from Amarith states that after Myrna's death Lenore de Hurst tried to tame a bulette in her stead.

Loot

Notable items obtained in this location, whether looted, purchased, or obtained as a quest reward:

  • Dog Collar - in a grave on the cliff overlooking Arcane Tower
  • Explorer's Ring - in the Bibberbang Grotto
  • Icy Crystal - dropped by Filro
  • Noblestalk - in the Bibberbang Grotto
  • Sussur Tree Bark

Notes and references
